chunks: Al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb, from ʿAbd al-Wahhāb ibn al-Ṣabbāḥ, from ʿAlī ibn Abī Ḥamzah, from Abū Baṣīr, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: concerning

A man was struck in his ear, and he claimed that one of his ears had lost some of its hearing. He said: “The one that was struck is to be tightly blocked, and the sound ear is to be left open. A bell is rung for it from the direction of his face, and he is told: ‘Listen.’ When the sound becomes indistinct to him, its place is marked. Then the bell is taken behind him and rung for him from behind until the sound becomes indistinct to him; then its place is marked. Then the distance between the two is measured; if it is equal, it is known that he has spoken truthfully. Then it is taken to his right side and rung until the sound becomes indistinct to him; then its place is marked. Then the distance between the two is measured; if it is equal, it is known that he has spoken truthfully. Then it is taken to his left side and rung until the sound becomes indistinct to him; then it is marked, and the distance between the two is measured; if it is equal, it is known that he has spoken truthfully.”

He said: “Then his affected ear is opened and the other is blocked well. Then the bell is rung in front of him, and the place where the sound becomes indistinct to him is marked. Then the same procedure is carried out with him as was done the first time with his sound ear. Then the difference between the sound ear and the affected ear is measured, and he is given the compensation according to that.”

key_terms.أُذُنِهِ: his ear; the bodily organ under legal examination in the injury case
key_terms.الصَّحِيحَةُ: the sound one; the healthy ear used as the baseline for comparison
key_terms.الصَّوْتُ: the sound; the auditory signal whose perceptibility is measured
key_terms.الْأَرْشَ: financial compensation; assessed indemnity for partial bodily injury
key_terms.الْجَرَسِ: the bell; the instrument used to test the range of hearing
key_terms.الْمُعْتَلَّةُ: the affected one; the injured ear whose diminished function is evaluated
key_terms.سَمْعِهَا: its hearing; the auditory capacity whose loss is being assessed
key_terms.صَدَقَ: he spoke truthfully; confirmation of the claimant's honesty through testing

ai.seo_question: How is compensation determined in Shia fiqh for partial hearing loss caused by injury to the ear?
ai.summary: This hadith sets out a legal procedure for verifying a claim of partial hearing loss after injury to the ear. It explains a method of comparative testing between the sound ear and the affected ear so that financial compensation may be assessed proportionately and justly.
